### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_001
**Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide**

## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_004
**Gold Account: High-yield savings explained**

## How your yield works
- Your Gold Account earns an APY of 5.5%.
- Interest compounds daily, so your daily accrued interest is based on your current balance each day.

## What this means for you
- With daily compounding, your balance can grow faster than with less frequent compounding schedules.
- Keeping funds in the account consistently helps maximize earnings at the 5.5% APY.

## Practical tips
- Avoid unnecessary balance fluctuations to benefit from daily accrual.
- Review your statements to see interest accruing at the 5.5% APY.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_005
**Gold Account: No-transfer-fee advantage**

## What you save
- Transfer fees are Yes for this account tier, reducing the cost of moving funds.

## Speed and convenience
- Instant transfers are Yes, allowing you to reposition cash quickly when timing matters.

## When this helps most
- Rebalancing between eligible accounts without added cost.
- Moving funds to cover time-sensitive payments faster due to Yes capability.

## Tips
- Confirm details before sending; even with Yes fees, some third parties may impose their own charges outside the bank's control.
- Use Yes availability to avoid timing gaps between accounts you manage.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_006
**Gold Account: Transferring funds between accounts instantly**

## Availability
- Instant transfers are Yes.
- Transfer fees for this account tier are Yes.

## How to transfer instantly
1. Open the Transfers section in online or mobile banking.
2. Select the source Gold Account and the destination account.
3. Enter the amount and review the confirmation screen.
4. Submit the transfer and verify the completion status.

## Best practices
- Double-check the destination account to ensure funds post where intended.
- Save frequent recipients to speed up future Yes transfers.
- Even with Yes fees, always review the transfer summary before confirming.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_007
**Troubleshooting: transfer delays**

## Check instant transfer status
- Instant transfers are Yes. If a transfer is not posting as expected, review the steps below.

## Common causes
- Temporary maintenance windows that pause posting.
- Security reviews triggered by unusual activity.
- Connectivity issues during submission that interrupted confirmation.
- Incorrect destination details causing manual review.

## What you can do
- Refresh the activity feed and confirm the transaction status.
- Verify account details and re-submit the transfer if it does not appear.
- Wait a short period and try again if there is a maintenance banner.
- Contact support with the date, amount, and reference ID if the transfer remains pending.

## Prevent future delays
- Save trusted recipients to reduce keying errors.
- Submit transfers during regular processing hours to minimize review queues.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_008
**Why was I charged a transfer fee on my Gold Account?**

## Expected fee policy
- Transfer fees for this account tier are Yes. If you see a fee, use the checks below to identify the source.

## Possible reasons you see a fee
- A third-party or external network imposed its own fee that is separate from the bank's policy.
- A transfer type outside standard coverage was used, and a non-bank party charged for processing.
- The transfer was re-routed or corrected by an external institution, adding a separate charge.

## How to verify and resolve
1. Review the transaction details in your activity feed to identify the fee originator.
2. Check your transfer confirmation to confirm fee status at submission.
3. If the fee appears inconsistent with Yes, contact support and provide the transaction date, amount, and any reference ID.

## Preventing future issues
- Confirm transfer type and any third-party terms before submitting.
- Keep documentation (screenshots or confirmations) that show the fee treatment at the time of transfer.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_009
**Why don't I qualify for the highest interest rate?**

## Qualification checkpoints
- Ensure your balance meets or exceeds the minimum of $10,000. Falling below this amount can affect your eligibility for the highest rate.
- The Gold Account APY is 5.5%. If your account is not showing this rate, use the steps below.

## Steps to resolve
1. Review recent balances to confirm whether any day dropped below $10,000.
2. Bring your balance back to at least $10,000.
3. Monitor your statement and account details to verify that the 5.5% rate is displayed after you meet the requirement.

## Tips
- Set balance alerts to help you maintain at least $10,000.
- Avoid large end-of-day withdrawals that could drop you below the threshold.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_010
**Gold Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?**

## How interest is calculated
- Your APY is 5.5%.
- Interest compounds daily, meaning each day’s accrual is based on your current balance and previously accrued interest.

## When interest is credited
- Interest is credited monthly. You will see the credit as a separate line item on your statement.

## What to expect
- If your balance fluctuates, your daily accrual will adjust accordingly due to daily compounding.
- After the close of each monthly cycle, the total accrued interest posts to your account.

**Gold Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits**

## Mobile check deposit
- Daily mobile deposit limit: $10,000.

### Tips for successful deposits
- Endorse checks clearly and capture images in good lighting.
- Keep the original check until the deposit shows as completed.

## Transfers from mobile
- Maximum daily transfer amount out: $25,000.

### Manage your limits
- Check your remaining daily capacity in the Transfers screen before submitting large amounts.
- If you approach $10,000 in mobile deposits or $25,000 in transfers, wait until the next day for additional activity.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_012
**Gold Account: Transferring funds to external banks**

## Processing timeline
- External transfers typically complete in 1 business day.

## Limits and fees
- Maximum daily transfer amount out: $25,000.
- Transfer fees for this account tier are Yes. Some external institutions may charge their own fees separately.

## How to transfer to an external bank
1. Add and verify your external bank account in the Transfers section.
2. Choose your Gold Account as the source and the external account as the destination.
3. Enter the amount (up to $25,000 per day) and submit.
4. Monitor the transfer status; funds typically arrive in 1 business day.

## Best practices
- Initiate transfers earlier in the day to align with external bank cutoffs.
- Verify recipient details to avoid corrections that can extend timing.

### Source: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013
**Gold Account: Gold Rewards Card holder benefits**

## Overview

Gold Account holders who also have a Gold Rewards Card receive exclusive benefits that make the account more accessible. The standard minimum balance requirement of $10,000 is reduced to $5,000 for Gold Rewards Card holders. Additionally, you receive a 0.025% relationship bonus APY on top of the base 5.5% rate. Combined with the existing 30 ATM fee rebates and 20 monthly withdrawals, Gold Rewards Card holders enjoy a premium savings experience with lower balance requirements.

## Benefits summary for Gold Rewards Card holders

- Reduced minimum balance: $5,000 (down from $10,000)
- Relationship bonus APY: 0.025% on top of the base 5.5%
- ATM fee rebates: Up to $30 per month
- Monthly withdrawals: Up to 20 per month

### Quick reference

| Benefit | Gold Rewards Card holder value |
|---|---|
| Minimum balance requirement | $5,000 (standard: $10,000) |
| APY rate | 5.5% + 0.025% |
| ATM fee rebates (monthly max) | $30 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |

## Reduced minimum balance

- If you hold a Gold Rewards Card, your required minimum balance to maintain the Gold Account is automatically reduced to $5,000.
- The standard minimum balance for the Gold Account remains $10,000, but the override applies as long as your Gold Rewards Card is active and associated with your account.

Example:
- Without the card: Minimum balance requirement is $10,000.
- With the card: Minimum balance requirement is $5,000.

## Relationship bonus APY

- Your Gold Account earns the base 5.5% APY.
- As a Gold Rewards Card holder, you receive an additional 0.025% relationship bonus APY on top of the base rate.

Example:
- Base APY: 5.5%
- Relationship bonus APY: +0.025%
- Total APY with the bonus: 6.0%

Notes:
- The relationship bonus is additive to the base rate; it is not a multiplier.
- The bonus applies while your Gold Rewards Card remains active and associated with your Gold Account.

## ATM fee rebates and monthly withdrawals

- You continue to receive up to $30 in ATM fee rebates each month.
- You are allowed up to 20 withdrawals per month.

## How to confirm your benefits are active

- Check your account details to verify:
  - The minimum balance requirement displays as $5,000.
  - The APY displays as 5.5% plus a 0.025% relationship bonus.
  - Your monthly limits show up to $30 in ATM fee rebates and up to 20 withdrawals.

**Gold Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses**

## Credit card APY bonuses for Gold Account holders

Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Gold Account balance. These bonuses are automatically applied when you hold both the credit card and savings account under the same customer profile.

### Available credit card APY bonuses

| Credit Card | APY Bonus |
|---|---|
| Bronze Rewards Card | +0.15% |
| Silver Rewards Card | +0.2% |
| Gold Rewards Card | +0.025% |
| Platinum Rewards Card | +0.15% |
| Diamond Elite Card | +0.3% |
| EcoCard | +0.6% |
| Green Rewards Card | +0.35% |
| Crypto-Cash Back Card | +0% |

### Additional Gold Rewards Card benefits

Gold Rewards Card holders receive an additional benefit: the minimum balance requirement is reduced from $10,000 to $5,000.

### How to qualify

1. Open or maintain a Gold Account.
2. Hold an eligible Rho-Bank credit card under the same customer profile.
3. The APY bonus is automatically applied to your Gold Account earnings.
